name: Epic Sacred Helm
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Sacred Helm

effects.name: Negative Energy Absorption
effects.tooltip: Negative Energy Absorption : This effect absorbs negative energy and energy drain effects.

effects.name: Lifesealed
effects.tooltip: Lifesealed +27 : You are immune to magical effects that cause instant death. In addition, you have a +27% enhancement bonus to Negative Energy Absorption .

effects.name: Hallowed
effects.tooltip: Hallowed : An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead . Hallowed items provide an +9 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.

effects.name: Sacred
effects.tooltip: Sacred +9 : An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead . Sacred items provide an +9 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead .

effects.name: Radiance Guard
effects.tooltip: Radiance Guard : This item is imbued with a brilliant, radiant power. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, the attacker has a chance of being hit by 4d6 points of light damage and has a chance of being blinded.

effects.name: Epic Divine Blessing
effects.tooltip: Epic Divine Blessing : 2 Pieces Equipped: +4% Artifact bonus to Light, Alignment, and Positive Spellcrit Chance +30 Artifact bonus to Light, Alignment, and Positive Spellpower

flavor_text: Though used primarily by drow ascetics, this helm will protect any healer from death magic and the undead.
